Training-budget sweep - SAIL alignment probing
Train: first N CC3M pairs (nested). Eval: COCO-2K, 2000 images, 5-caption protocol.
Score = MR(5cap) = mean of i2t/t2i R@1/5/10. GT = downstream 11-benchmark average.
PFLOPs = mean cost per tokenizer: vision+text encoding + alignment training
         + the COCO-2K retrieval evaluation (2xMAC convention).
